headline: Last session: Sensex tumbled 876 points while Nifty dropped to 22,888 as banking and IT stocks led losses.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: BSE and NSE are closed today, October 20, 2026, for the Dussehra trading holiday.
In the last trading session on October 19, the Sensex tumbled 876.37 points to settle at 73,852.90.
Nifty 50 dropped 1.11% to close at 22,888.95 during Monday's market crash.
Banking and IT stocks led the sharp market downturn in the previous session.
whatHappening: Indian stock exchanges are shut for Dussehra and trading will resume on Wednesday, October 21.
Investors are focusing on maximizing allotment chances under the Rs 2,500 crore RIL shareholders quota for the Jio IPO.
Bajaj Finance doubled its gold loan portfolio before pulling the plug on one of its gold loan schemes.
Enforcement Directorate froze accounts worth Rs 200 crore amid warnings over WhatsApp stock tip pump-and-dump schemes.
summary: Indian equity markets are closed today, October 20, on account of Dussehra, with normal trading resuming on Wednesday. In the last session on October 19, benchmark indices suffered a sharp sell-off as Sensex fell over 876 points and Nifty dropped to 22,888.95. Heavy losses in banking and IT sector stocks drove the market drop on Monday.
